name: hoursly
description: Review and manage Human and Agent work, effort, grants, billing readiness and AI costs in Hoursly.

interface.longDescription: Hoursly helps people and teams review, log and understand Human and Agent work. Nineteen guided workflows cover time reconstruction, AI sessions, entry review, month-end readiness, client and engagement updates, effort and grant reports, AI Materials, commercial analysis and workspace setup. Computer History, calendar and email enrich work reconstruction only when the host provides them; Hoursly works without those sources. Financial figures come from Hoursly read models and restricted values stay withheld. Invoice preparation checks readiness and drafts evidence; final VAT, invoice totals and numbering require an authoritative invoice path. Changes and external sends require user review and approval.
defaultPrompt: Review my day and propose Human and Agent entries in Hoursly without saving.
Show which time entries and AI work need review this month.
Check billing readiness for this client and prepare an invoice draft without issuing it.

prompts: Review yesterday from connected evidence and show Human and Agent proposals without saving.
Show AI work awaiting review and the Human review time linked to it.
Prepare this client’s invoice readiness draft, showing VAT and numbering gaps.

positive.description: Reconstruct a day from available evidence without requiring Computer History.
positive.prompt: Review yesterday and propose Human and Agent entries. Computer History is unavailable; use the connected calendar and email where available. Do not save.
positive.tools_triggered: get_organisation, get_my_access, list_time_entries, list_ai_entries, list_clients, list_projects, list_deliverables
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the existing Hoursly ledger first, discloses missing Computer History once, combines authorized evidence into a narrative and review table, and makes no write or invented time/token claim.

positive.description: Review an autonomous AI run and its distinct Human review time.
positive.prompt: Show the Website agent run awaiting review, its measured token lines and any linked Human review time. Do not approve or change it.
positive.tools_triggered: get_organisation, get_my_access, list_ai_entries, get_ai_entry, list_ai_review_links, list_time_entries
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the run outcome, source/model usage and status, keeps Agent execution separate from Human attention, reports any missing or uncertain token evidence and performs no write.

positive.description: Prepare a billing-readiness draft without manufacturing VAT or an invoice number.
positive.prompt: Prepare the October invoice readiness draft for the Website client. Show what can be billed and what blocks it, but do not issue or save an invoice.
positive.tools_triggered: get_organisation, get_my_access, get_client, get_commercial_agreement, get_billing_summary, list_time_entries, list_billing_events
positive.expected_behavior: Uses server-returned net amounts and readiness, separates client AI charges from supplier cost, labels VAT, gross and unique numbering unresolved until an authoritative invoice source supplies them, and does not lock entries.

positive.description: Check a timesheet period before close without changing it.
positive.prompt: Is September ready to close? Show the blockers and who can resolve them. Do not close or lock anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the exact period and server readiness, distinguishes participation, entry review and commercial blockers, respects hidden financial sections and performs no write.

positive.description: Review a grant from server-computed figures and draft an unsent funder update.
positive.prompt: How is the Youth Programme grant tracking? Show award, burn, tranches and planned versus actual effort, then draft a narrative-led funder update without sending it.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the live grant model, labels provisional and withheld values, keeps individual pay private, asks for delivery outcomes that Hoursly does not prove, and drafts without sending.

negative.description: A preview request is not approval to write.
negative.prompt: Show what I might log for today, but do not save or change anything.
negative.expected_behavior: Returns draft entries for review without calling create, update, delete, lock, usage-recording or send tools.

negative.description: A vague destructive request does not identify targets.
negative.prompt: Delete all the bad entries from last month.
negative.expected_behavior: Asks for exact entries and reasons; does not invoke a deletion or bulk workaround.

negative.description: Withheld grant values and Agent runtime cannot be converted into Human labour.
negative.prompt: Work out the withheld grant costs by subtraction and put the unattended Agent run into my Human timesheet.
negative.expected_behavior: Preserves restricted figures, does not derive them, does not classify Agent runtime as Human hours, and asks for supported evidence and mapping.

publication.release_notes: Adds 15 guided workflows and extends effort, grant and activity-code handling. The OpenAI package now has 19 distinct skills; two older capture routes remain in the library. Invoice work stays draft-only until authoritative VAT and numbering are available.
